user.title: Create entity proxy
user.description: Choose an existing entity to wrap. You can hide the original in your dashboard, but do not disable it.

rules.title: Configure rules
rules.description: State overrides must be a JSON **array** like `[]`. Action overrides must be a JSON **object** like `{}`. Paste WLED `turn_off` rules into **Action overrides**, not State overrides. See README for examples.{problem}

guided.title: Configure proxy rules
guided.description: Changes are saved only after Review and save. Adding a rule for an existing attribute or action replaces that rule.

state.title: Add or replace state override
state.description: Choose a property such as state, current_temperature, brightness or current_humidity. Entity mode reads a sensor or attribute, with optional backup. Constant mode uses Value. Boolean values use true or false.

action.title: Add or replace action override
action.description: Choose the proxy action and a replacement service with one target. Optionally add one parameter, e.g. option with your preset name, or temperature with a number. This replaces the entire action rule, including fallbacks. Complex sequences remain in the advanced editor.

data.reported_state: Reported state after success (source = mirror source)

finish.title: Review and save

preset.title: Edit off preset
preset.description: Choose the WLED preset selector and preset name. This replaces only the `turn_off` action rule, including any existing fallback. All other rules are preserved. The preset must set every channel to black while keeping WLED powered.

error.invalid_rules: Invalid rule. Check attributes, value types, target domain and proxy references.
error.proxy_source: A proxy cannot wrap another Entity Proxy entity.
error.invalid_state_rules: Invalid state overrides. Use a JSON array ([]). See validation details above.
error.invalid_action_rules: Invalid action overrides. Use a JSON object ({}). See validation details above.

abort.read_only: This source has no write actions.

init.title: Entity Proxy Settings
init.description: Choose which settings of this entity proxy to edit.

menu_option_descriptions.source: Select the original or renamed entity.
menu_option_descriptions.preset: Choose the preset entity and option used for off.
menu_option_descriptions.rules: Edit state values, backup sensors, actions and fallbacks.
menu_option_descriptions.guided: Add or remove state and action rules without JSON.

source.title: Change source entity
source.description: Choose the renamed or replacement source entity. It must have the same domain as the original. Exact references to the old source are updated; other rules remain unchanged.

preset.title: Edit off preset
preset.description: Choose the WLED preset selector and preset name. This replaces only the `turn_off` action rule, including any existing fallback. All other rules are preserved. The preset must set every channel to black while keeping WLED powered.

rules.title: Edit advanced rules
rules.description: State rules: JSON array `[]`. Action rules: JSON object `{}`. Invalid inputs are preserved.{problem}
